elenapm: Quick sync: Synergy (reseller) asked for a compact POC runbook covering tenant provisioning, pricing tiers, and security controls. Need to deliver by Wed.
chris_partner: They want per-customer isolation for billing and logs but like the idea of a pooled compute model to save cost. Also asked about self-serve provisioning.
ade_sales: Pricing question: give two scenarios for a 3-customer pilot: reserved per-tenant vs shared pooled. Also need a simple spike estimate for 99th percentile token usage.
mike_infra: We can support both. Suggested setup: pooled Dedicated pool with tenant weights, and option to carve dedicated slices per customer. Provisioning lead time differs: pooled = 3 days, dedicated slices = 8 days.
tara_sec: Security: confirm SSO flow (brokered vs direct). For PHI/regulated customers, recommend per-tenant CMKs and tenant-scoped audit streams. Any PHI in pilot?
elenapm: Two pilot customers may have regulated data; flagged legal. Synergy wants to use their Okta broker for onboarding.
chris_partner: Okta brokered SSO confirmed. They also asked for read-only access to per-customer logs for troubleshooting, with PII redaction.
ade_sales: For initial numbers, can we say reserved slice cost ~ $6.5k/month per customer for 3 vGPU equivalent; pooled cost ~ $17k/month for 6 vGPU pool (~$5.7k/customer) + metered egress.
mike_infra: That matches our roughs. I'll open infra-ticket and pre-create two demo tenants and a pooled cluster. ops-bot: ticket-55100 created by mike_infra: "Synergy POC - pooled cluster + demo tenants" ETA 3d.
tara_sec: For the PHI ones: require HSM-backed KMS and separate retention policies. I'll draft the security checklist and an appendix for the SOW.
elenapm: Owners: tara -> security appendix & KMS decision, mike -> infra ticket + demo pods, ade -> pricing spreadsheet, chris -> coordinate Synergy test IdP and log access.
chris_partner: I'll gather test IdP metadata and confirm which customers are PHI.
ade_sales: I'll post a short spreadsheet with assumptions and 95th/99th token lines tonight.
mike_infra: Demo note: provisioning CLI example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/tenants -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"name":"synergy-cust1","tier":"pilot","quota":{}}'``` will show in demo.
tara_sec: Also include runbook step to enable tenant-scoped log redaction and retention config in console.
elenapm: Blockers: (1) KMS choice for PHI tenants (tara), (2) demo provisioning automation proof (mike), (3) pricing doc with pct estimates (ade). Review meeting Mon 11am PT. :calendar:
